name: SJVN Ltd
title: SJVN Ltd - 533206 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: SJVN's FY26 PAT was flat at INR 1,008 crore, with Q4 lifted by a one-off INR 679 crore tariff true-up; new Buxar thermal and solar are loss-making until PLF and CUF ramp, and management has put its 25 GW target under review.

utilisation.quote: it has started operating at a PLF of around 60%. Once this PLF goes up to around 70% plus, this plant will start bringing in profit.

capex.peers_comment: Management said tenders from SJVNL, NHAI, SECI and NTPC have all signed only 25% to 30% of capacity, with tariffs falling in later bids.
capex.quote: this year we have a CAPEX plan of around 9,400 and for FY '28 and FY '29, we have a plan of 7,800 and 7,500 respectively.

triggers.label: 25 GW / 50 GW targets under review
triggers.quote: But the target which you were speaking about 25,000, 50,000, that is that we are reviewing it.

triggers.label: Buxar Unit-1 PLF ~60%, loss-making
triggers.quote: it has started operating at a PLF of around 60%. Once this PLF goes up to around 70% plus, this plant will start bringing in profit.

triggers.label: RE PPAs signed ~6 of 16 GW
triggers.quote: we have awarded a contract of around like 16 Gigawatts, 16,000 Megawatts and out of that, we have signed a PSA of around 6 Gigawatt.

triggers.label: Bikaner curtailment ~120 MW of 1,000 MW
triggers.quote: there is a curtailment of around 120 Megawatt. So, that is due to the SVR requirement.

guidance.value: Buxar 660 MW thermal, Dhaulasidh 69.5 MW hydro, ~1,555 MW solar by March 2027

red_flags.label: Unbilled revenue INR 906 cr; tariff order-driven revenue spike
red_flags.quote: This includes INR 906 crores as unbilled debtors as on 31st March '26 as against INR 136 crores as on 31st March '25.

red_flags.label: SGEL loss INR 258 cr on revenue INR 510 cr
red_flags.quote: That translates to a loss of INR 258 crores in this year as compared to INR 151 crores in the last year.

red_flags.label: Impairment INR 174 cr under Ind AS 36
red_flags.quote: recognition of impairment losses amounting to INR 174 crores as per AS36.

evasions.quote: Very, very difficult to say anything as of now.

evasions.topic: Renewable tender demand and PPA pendency
evasions.quote: there is a possibility that all the PPAs may not be done
